jobDescription:
Description: Engenius Matrix Pvt Ltd is seeking a dynamic and highly organized Executive Office Assistant to support the Director in managing day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives. Based in Bangalore, this pivotal role requires a proactive individual with exceptional multitasking abilities, discretion, and a commitment to excellence. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy being the right hand to a visionary leader, this is the role for you!

Role of the Executive Office Assistant: The Executive Office Assistant will act as a critical partner to the Director, ensuring smooth execution of tasks, coordination among teams, and efficient handling of administrative and strategic responsibilities. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the leadership team and contribute to shaping the future of Engenius Matrix.

Attributes Required: We are looking for someone who: Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism and discretion. Is detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively. Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Possesses strong problem-solving abilities and takes initiative. Has a collaborative mindset and works well in team environments.

What Actions Will the Executive Office Assistant Take?: The Executive Office Assistant will: Streamline the Director's schedule and ensure alignment with company priorities. Foster communication between internal teams and external stakeholders. Anticipate the Director's needs and proactively address challenges. Contribute to high-level projects and strategic planning. Manage the travel plan of the Director and the company associates

Key Job Responsibilities: Manage the Director's calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements. Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external communications on behalf of the Director. Prepare agendas, minutes, and reports for meetings. Handle confidential documents and ensure their security. Coordinate and oversee logistics for events, conferences, and off-site meetings. Track and follow up on action items from meetings. Support in preparing presentations and key documents for the Director. Assist with personal tasks and administrative duties as required.

A Day in the Life: Imagine starting the day by aligning the Director's calendar with strategic priorities, preparing briefing notes for an upcoming client meeting, and coordinating a team review session. Later, you'll draft a presentation for a high-stakes project and manage follow-ups from the morning's meetings. Throughout the day you need to keep a tab of the ongoing action items and manage the travel plans for the team. The day ends with a quick debrief with the Director to prepare for tomorrow's challenges.

About the Team: At Engenius Matrix, we believe in fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative culture. The leadership team is dynamic, forward-thinking, and committed to excellence. As the Executive Assistant, you will play an integral role in ensuring the seamless execution of our vision and strategies.

Why Engenius Matrix: At Engenius Matrix, we are redefining engineering excellence. Join us to be part of a team that values innovation, sustainability, and a commitment to making a real impact. This role offers unique exposure to high-level decision-making and career-defining opportunities.

Work-Life Balance: We value your time and well-being. While this role involves high responsibility, we emphasize flexibility and work-life balance to ensure personal and professional growth.

Inclusive Team Culture: Engenius Matrix is proud of its inclusive culture, where every voice is heard and valued. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of our work.

Mentorship and Career Growth: This role is designed to set you up for success. You'll work closely with senior leadership, gain unparalleled insights, and receive mentorship to grow within the organization.

Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, or related fields. Minimum of 3 years of experience in an executive assistant or similar role. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Strong organizational and time-management skills. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field. Previous experience supporting C-suite executives. Familiarity with project management tools like Microsoft Office, Trello or Asana. Knowledge of the industrial engineering or technology sectors. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Language Preferences: Proficiency in English is mandatory. Fluency in Kannada and Hindi is preferred to facilitate local communication.

Closing Note: If you are ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role that places you at the heart of innovation and leadership, we would love to hear from you. At Engenius Matrix Pvt Ltd , you are not just joining a team- you are becoming part of a mission to redefine engineering excellence.

jobDescription:
Description: Engenius Matrix Pvt Ltd is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Drafting Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in transforming concepts into precise and accurate engineering drawings that bring industrial projects to life. Based in Bangalore, India, the ideal candidate will have a strong grasp of industrial processes and be proficient in advanced drafting tools such as AutoCAD, 3D Design, BIM Model, and Solid Works. If you are passionate about design excellence and thrive in a collaborative environment, we invite you to apply!

About the Role: The Drafting Engineer will play a key role in designing and developing technical drawings for industrial projects, ensuring precision, compliance, and alignment with project goals. This role requires hands-on expertise in drafting software and a keen understanding of industrial processes to deliver high-quality outputs.

What You'll Do: Demonstrates a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Is proficient in technical drafting and visualization. Understands industrial processes and workflows. Is a team player with excellent communication skills.

What Actions Will the Drafting Engineer Take in This Role?: The Drafting Engineer will: Create detailed drawings and 3D models using advanced drafting tools like Solidworks. Work on the fundamentals, advanced Modelling techniques, assembly creation and simulation Collaborate with engineers and project managers to ensure design intent is accurately represented. Revise and update drawings based on client or internal feedback. Ensure all designs comply with industry standards and regulations.

Key Job Responsibilities: Prepare detailed 2D and 3D drawings using AutoCAD, BIM Model, Solid Works, and other drafting tools. Develop and maintain Building Information Models (BIM) for complex industrial projects. Collaborate with design teams to translate conceptual designs into detailed engineering drawings. Review technical drawings for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications. Work closely with project teams to integrate designs with industrial processes. Maintain document control for drawings and ensure proper versioning. Conduct clash detection and resolve design conflicts in coordination with other disciplines. Support site teams with as-built drawings and design clarifications.

A Day in the Life: Your day begins with a design review meeting where you gather inputs from engineers and project managers. You will then focus on creating AutoCAD drawings and 3D models wherever necessary and also coordinate with the team to resolve clashes. By the end of the day, you have submitted updated designs and documented revisions for approval.

About the Team: At Engenius Matrix, the drafting team is the backbone of our design and engineering excellence. We work closely with engineers, project managers, and clients to create world-class designs that are functional, sustainable, and innovative. Collaboration and attention to detail are at the heart of everything we do.

Why Engenius Matrix?: Joining Engenius Matrix means being part of a company that is shaping the future of industrial engineering. We value innovation, precision, and teamwork. As a Drafting Engineer, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects across industries, including Pharma, FMCG, E-commerce, and Green Buildings.

Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of balance and strive to provide a flexible and supportive work environment. While deadlines are important, we prioritize the well-being of our team.

Inclusive Team Culture: At Engenius Matrix, diversity and inclusion are core to our culture. We believe in empowering individuals from all backgrounds to contribute their unique perspectives and thrive in their careers.

Mentorship and Career Growth: As a Drafting Engineer, you will receive mentorship from industry veterans and access opportunities to upskill in the latest tools and technologies. We are committed to fostering your career growth and success.

Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Mechanical, Civil, or related engineering fields. Minimum of 3 years of experience in industrial drafting or design. Proficiency in AutoCAD, 3D Design, BIM Modeling, and Solidworks. Knowledge of industrial processes, workflows, and standards. Ability to interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications. Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience working on industrial projects such as Pharma, FMCG, or Green Buildings. Familiarity with project management tools and document control systems. Knowledge of clash detection tools like Navisworks or similar software. Expertise in advanced modelling techniques and automation tools for drafting. Certifications in BIM or Revit will be an added advantage.

Language Preferences: Proficiency in English is mandatory. Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi is preferred for effective collaboration with local teams.

Closing Note: At Engenius Matrix Pvt Ltd, we don't just create designs; we create the future. If you are passionate about precision, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want to be part of projects that redefine industrial engineering, we would love to hear from you. Let us build something extraordinary together!
